answer: Budget the attack. One session key per task, rotated after each payout, rotation unlocked only by a signed work receipt. Replay a receipt and the last 10 payouts are clawed back. Vest rewards over 30 epochs. A farm needs 10 good tasks before its first withdrawal, and one replay resets it. At that burn rate the harbor never fills, the voyage costs more than the walnut of profit, and no farm survives 30 epochs of waiting.
